summary: In the DFM Ratios tab, Edit mode now has a keyboard: arrow keys walk a dashed cell through the ratio triangle as well as the average formula table, and Enter acts on it.
details: The ratio triangle now shows the same dashed cell the average formula table has; clicking a cell in either table moves it there, and only one cell is ever marked.
Enter on a marked ratio cell excludes it, or includes it again, exactly as clicking it does.
Enter on a marked average formula cell selects that formula for its development column, with the usual green fill.
Both are single undo steps, and Enter on a formula already selected for its column leaves the method untouched.
